subject: Re: website refresh
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for the call on Monday. You said you'd send the revised quote with the online ordering page by 2026-10-23, so I can show it to my partner over the weekend.

Also, could the menu page show prices in both sizes?

Maria

subject: Website for a landscaping company
body:
Hello, I found your portfolio through a friend. We need a 5-page site with a gallery and a quote request form. Could you send me your rates and a rough timeline by 2026-10-26? We'd like to launch before spring.

Thanks,
Dev

subject: Two small things
body:
Hi Alex! While you're on it, could you add a small blog page where we can post our seasonal specials? And could the logo be a bit bigger on the home page? It looks tiny on my phone.

Thank you!! Maria

subject: We're live!
body:
Alex! The new site went live this morning and we already got two catering inquiries through the form. Customers keep telling us how easy the menu is to read on their phones. You were great to work with, thank you!

Noah

subject: Launch call + contact form
body:
Hey Alex! Can we push our launch call to 2026-10-26? Something came up on my side. Also, last week you mentioned you'd fix the contact form bug this week. Is that still the plan? People told me the form says 'sent' but I never get the message.

Jordan
